kind: Evidence Memory 0.3.0 design replay and restore-packet comparison; raw-free aggregates

offline_replay.population: Maintainer's local Claude Code and Codex transcripts from September 2026. Only tool-name classes, counts and byte totals were computed; no tool input, output or name is recorded here.
offline_replay.prior_behaviour: Twelve real 0.2 indexes captured every tool call and recorded no organic retrieval.

network_shell_heuristic.decision: Not in the default scope: about 1-2 points more calls for 2-5 points more coverage of post-compaction restatements, while storing free-form command text and output.

input_text_matching.decision: Rejected: most input-only matches were the word tax in accounting queries, so input matching would withhold ordinary results.

automatic_number_linking.decision: Not built. Under external scope only 14.3% (Claude) and 11.6% (Codex) of numbers in session notes matched exactly one captured result.

restore_packet_comparison.population: Repository synthetic long-session fixture after three compactions with the source transcript deleted; Claude Sonnet, low effort; one run per case and arm; positive cases metric003, metric009 and metric045; failed-result case metric048.
restore_packet_comparison.isolation: claude --print with a relocated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR holding only credentials, empty setting sources, strict empty MCP configuration, schema-constrained answer, and an empty working directory so the index could not be found by listing. Model replies were scored in memory and not saved.
restore_packet_comparison.failed_result_case: Every arm answered unavailable. This case cannot distinguish retrieval from absence, because unavailable is also the answer without evidence.
restore_packet_comparison.first_rung_control_repair: A first run used the index directory as the working directory; the no-skill control then read the database directly and answered correctly without retrieval. It was discarded and rerun with an empty working directory.
restore_packet_comparison.limits: Screen-grade: three positive cases per arm. The question names the metric, so this measures retrieval when a need is explicit, not whether a model notices an unprompted need after compaction. Counted model usage sums CLI input, cache-creation, cache-read and output counts, including fixed host context, and is not a billing estimate. Live long-session benefit remains unmeasured.
